verses.text: The word of the Lord, which came vnto Zephaniah ye sonne of Cushi, the sonne of Gedaliah, the sonne of Amariah, the sonne of Hizkiah, in the dayes of Iosiah, the sonne of Amon King of Iudah.
Gather your selues, euen gather you, O nation not worthie to be loued,
Woe to her that is filthie and polluted, to the robbing citie.
